description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-tick.ts to satisfy the following request. The relevant code is in the region "scripts". If that file is the wrong target, say so rather than editing it.

In scripts/substrate/vessels.inventory.json, relevance-sink-vessel.service has role compute, but its unit declares After=surrealdb.service and the vessel writes SurrealDB directly, so on a spoke (which includes compute and excludes store) it runs healthy while every write fails. Change its role to store.
